name: Puzzle Fuzzy
summary: Puzzle Fuzzy is a cozy block puzzle where everything is made of handcrafted felt, starring a fluffy mascot named Fuzzy. Drag felt blocks onto an 8x8 board, clear rows and columns and chain combos. There are no timers and it plays offline. It includes a 15-stage level map, daily challenges with stars and a streak, mission chests, two boosters (a Bomb that clears 3x3 and a Refresh that swaps pieces) and cozy themes.
